xaerominimap_hidden_radar_skip.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on MinimapProcessor.onClientTick's RadarSession.update call: left out while no screen is open and MinimapRenderer.renderMinimap (@Inject HEAD) did not run in the last frame (GameRenderer.render(DeltaTracker, boolean) HEAD @Inject counts frames); the first update left out empties every radar list, the next renderMinimap runs RadarSession.update with the last tick's world, camera entity and player before drawing; updates without a world always run. Shares the wrapped call with xaerominimap_radar_after_frame (the outer wrapper decides for both). Runtime flag xaerominimapHiddenRadarSkip. Helper bons.furious.patch.xaerominimap_c49.RadarPacing.
xaerominimap_hidden_radar_skip.license: All Rights Reserved (Xaero's Minimap): none of its code is carried; the wrapper only decides when its radar update runs

xaerominimap_map_redraw_cap.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapMethod on MinimapFBORenderer.renderChunksToFBO: the original runs when the last redraw is at least 1/value s old or any structural input changed (either framebuffer object or size, view size, shape, north lock, cave level, world map use, cave mode, map dimension and scale, zoom, the map writer's loaded array, origin and level count); otherwise it is left out and renderChunks shows the kept rotation framebuffer. Value PureConfig.intValue("xaerominimap_map_redraw_cap", 60, 1, 1000) redraws per second. Runtime flag xaerominimapMapRedrawCap. Helper bons.furious.patch.xaerominimap_c49.MapRedrawCap.

xaerominimap_empty_element_renderer_skip.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on MinimapElementRendererHandler.render's renderForRenderer call: for the four renderers Xaero's Minimap builds (exact classes WaypointsIngameRenderer, WaypointsGuiRenderer, the radar's RadarRenderer, PlayerTrackerMinimapElementRenderer) the count drawn on the first frame of each client tick (MinimapProcessor.onClientTick HEAD @Inject; a radar rebuild outside the tick counts as a new tick) is kept per handler; on the tick's other frames a renderer that drew nothing runs renderForRenderer with its provider's begin / hasNext / end left out (@WrapOperation on those three calls), so preRender and postRender still run. Renderers of other mods always run. Runtime flag xaerominimapEmptyElementRendererSkip. Helper bons.furious.patch.xaerominimap_c49.EmptyElementSkip.
